name: Builders.to

sources.title: Official how-to — sign in via Google/GitHub/X at /signin, 'Share Project' from /projects, project goes live immediately at /projects/<slug>
llms.txt — free accounts share 1 project; Verified $25 one-time gets 2 projects + badge + recorded MVP review; Pro up to 5 projects
Homepage (search snippet) — 'permanent, indexed page with do-follow links — launch once, get found forever'; feed limited to 5 posts/day on free

requirements: Account required — sign in with Google, GitHub, or X at builders.to/signin
Free tier: 1 project, feed posting up to 5x/day, Discord access
Projects at any stage accepted: Idea → Building → Beta → Launched → Paused → Acquired
Paid upgrades: Verified $25 one-time (badge + recorded MVP review), Pro for more projects/reach
preparation: Project name, short description/tagline, URL, tags
Google, GitHub, or X account for sign-in
workflow: Sign in at builders.to/signin via Google, GitHub, or X
Go to builders.to/projects and click 'Share Project' (or quick-action in nav)
Fill name, description, stage, URL, tagline, tags; add images
Submit — project goes live immediately at /projects/<slug>, on your profile, and in the community feed
Post updates/milestones to the feed (5/day free limit) to sustain visibility
watchFor: Free tier caps at 1 project — pick the product that matters
Direct fetches of builders.to pages failed for us (search-index content used) — site may block non-browser clients
Community feed visibility decays without ongoing updates — 'launch once' page persists but engagement requires posting
Paid 'trending boosts' exist — organic reach may compete with paid placement
countsAsLive: The project has a public page at builders.to/projects/<slug> and appears on the /projects browse page and community feed
unknowns: Whether project pages stay indexed long-term for low-activity accounts
Moderation — do projects ever get rejected/removed post-publish
Whether the batch's /projects/new URL is the live form (site was unfetchable; how-to references 'Share Project' on /projects)
